bodyHtml:
Spindles United kicked off Year 4 with the 2025 Winter Showcase at Afrim’s Sports Malta.

The clubs first indoor-based event, this was the 3rd official showcase since our founding year inn 2022.

The event saw almost 30 players show out and participate, with a mixture of guys from previous seasons along with some brand new faces looking to join the club in 2025.

Spindles operates on a clean-slate roster system every season, so events like these are crucial for figuring out which players are serious about returning next season, and who make a great new addition.

Despite the snow, it was a great turnout for 2 hours of high energy, small-sided ball.

The evening started out with a quick warm up, then straight into 45 minutes of 3-minute, fast-paced games with constant rotations amongst the 4 teams.

By 4pm, the players took a short break for an informational session before heading back into 6v6 for another hour. This time in 10-minute intervals for a slower pace.

The session closed out by 5pm with a short closing statement, photos, and awarding 2 Spindles Scarves to 2 randomly selected players. Congrats Lucas McCane and Joakim Holst!

Another successful event for Spindles as we hear up for an exciting 2025.

Roster selection is a crucial part of ensuring a successful year both on and off the field and events like these play a big role in those decisions.

Thank you to all the players that participated! The full photo album from the event can be accessed here.

The club is in the midst of planning another showcase before the season, outside and full-field. Subscribe to our email list to be notified!
